note: mode: auto = measured by src/checks/measure.js; review = picture/video captured, a person (or Claude vision) judges. layouts: where it runs. viewport: desktop or mobile.

items.title: Close (X) button of the 'Compatibility issue detected' panel
items.steps: In the theme editor, turn on the core embed before choosing a theme in Theme list. Look at the panel's X button.
items.expected: X is visible, normal size, on the same line as the title, not shifted, not a square icon.

items.title: Magnifier icon and placeholder in 'Search in this collection' and 'Search filter value'
items.steps: Open /collections/all. Look at both search boxes.
items.expected: Icon shown whole (not cropped), not touching the placeholder, placeholder fully shown.

items.title: Value name and count on one line
items.steps: Look at the filter values in each box.
items.expected: Value and count share one line and one vertical centre.

items.title: Count stays readable on hover
items.steps: Hover over a filter value.
items.expected: Count colour has enough contrast against the hover background (not black on black).

items.title: Slider dots centred on the line
items.steps: Look at the Price slider.
items.expected: Both circle dots sit on the centre of the slider line.

items.title: Expand/collapse arrow and one-line row
items.steps: Find a merged value group. Click its arrow.
items.expected: Arrow is visible; checkbox, group name and arrow share one line; clicking expands and collapses.

items.title: Scroll-to-top button
items.steps: Scroll down the page.
items.expected: Findter's round button appears with an arrow inside, and the theme's own button is not shown at the same time.

items.title: Checkbox square and on one line with name and count
items.steps: Look at a Checklist-type filter.
items.expected: Checkbox is square (not a rectangle) and shares one line with name and count.

items.title: Filter by, Sort by and the sort dropdown aligned
items.steps: Look at the toolbar above the product grid.
items.expected: 'Sort by' label and dropdown share one line, nothing overlaps, no extra white background behind the dropdown.

items.title: 'Choose options' panel
items.steps: On a card with 'Choose options', click it.
items.expected: Variant options centred, Add to cart / View full detail stay inside the card, elements not crowded, panel not see-through.

items.title: A selected Checklist value looks selected
items.steps: Click one value of a Checklist filter.
items.expected: The box turns dark or shows a tick.

items.title: Chip 'Option: value' centred, with X
items.steps: After selecting a value, look at the chip.
items.expected: Text centred on one line; X icon present and not shifted.

items.title: App icons render normally
items.steps: Look at the dropdown, magnifier and X icons.
items.expected: Not enlarged, not turned into black blobs or odd shapes.

items.title: 'Filter by' button
items.steps: Look at the Filter by button on the left.
items.expected: Icon shown and aligned with the text.

items.title: Drawer opens
items.steps: Click Filter by.
items.expected: A right-side drawer opens with filter options.

items.title: Drawer close (X) button
items.steps: Open the drawer, look at X.
items.expected: Present, normal size, icon centred in its box.

items.title: Price From / To
items.steps: In the open drawer, look at the Price slider.
items.expected: From and To fully shown, not cut with '...'.

items.title: 'Filter and sort' button
items.steps: Open /collections/all at mobile width.
items.expected: Findter's button is shown; the theme's own Filter/Sort are not shown next to it.

items.title: Drawer, X and Sort options
items.steps: Open the drawer.
items.expected: X present and not shifted; Sort option text aligned left.

items.title: Price From / To
items.steps: Look at Price in the drawer.
items.expected: From and To fully shown.

items.title: 'Choose options' panel
items.steps: Open Choose options on a card.
items.expected: Same as V-09; cards not too close, nothing spills onto the next card.

items.title: Findter search suggestion appears
items.steps: Click the header magnifier, type 3.
items.expected: Findter's widget appears with the 'Powered by Findter' watermark.

items.title: Theme search bar still works
items.steps: Open search, type.
items.expected: Theme's search bar is present and accepts text.

items.title: Only one suggestion box
items.steps: Type 3 and look.
items.expected: Findter's widget and the theme's suggestion box are not shown together.

items.title: Widget width and position
items.steps: Compare the widget with the search bar.
items.expected: Same width (within the tolerance), directly under the bar, not covered by the header, not shifted.

items.title: Widget is stable
items.steps: Type, scroll up and down.
items.expected: Widget does not expand over the page or disappear on scroll.

items.title: Findter search template with watermark
items.steps: Open search on mobile.
items.expected: Findter's template shows, 'Powered by Findter' at the bottom.

items.title: Only one search layout
items.steps: Open search on mobile.
items.expected: The theme's own search layout is not shown with or instead of Findter's.

items.title: Back arrow
items.steps: Look for the back arrow next to the bar, then click it.
items.expected: Arrow is visible; click returns to the page without a second search bar.

items.title: Search bar usable
items.steps: Open search, type.
items.expected: Bar is visible and accepts text.

items.title: Findter started with products
items.steps: Open /collections/all.
items.expected: Findter container visible, product cards with image and price, no broken images.

items.title: No sideways scroll
items.steps: Open the page.
items.expected: Page does not scroll horizontally.

items.title: No Findter errors
items.steps: Open the page.
items.expected: No JavaScript errors or failed Findter requests.

items.title: The layout on screen is the layout that was set
items.steps: Set the Filter layout in Tab 1, Save, reload Tab 3.
items.expected: The page shows that layout (otherwise the other results do not mean anything).
